outdoor.note: 卧龙岗 and 绮云镇's ground floor: the road from Snow winds over 卧龙岗 to the town gate; the market street runs south from the gate, turns east and south again to the crossroad; the main street crosses the town east-west. Street rooms are stretches of one open road; shops and houses are buildings of their own sizes along it, each with its door onto the street it opens to.

roads: a road on the ridge and on the field; the path runs down the middle
